name: Eyebrow
purpose: A small kicker label placed above a section heading to categorise it (e.g. 'Payments', 'Recent activity'). Sentence case (house type rule). Sets context without competing with the heading. Surfaced as a missing pattern by the journey gap report.

props.name: text
props.$note: The kicker label; keep it to 1–3 words.

tokens.$type-finding: REVIEW: uses 13px / line-height 1 / 500, sentence case, with NO dedicated 'eyebrow' type token — confirm the size/role or bind to a label type token if one exists.

accessibility.role: None — a decorative <span>, NOT a heading, so it does not break heading order.
accessibility.screenReader: REVIEW (inferred): read inline before the heading it precedes. If purely decorative it may be redundant with the heading — confirm it adds meaning, otherwise consider aria-hidden.

antiPatterns: Uppercasing the eyebrow — house type rule is SENTENCE CASE; distinguish it by size / weight / colour, not capitalisation.
REVIEW (inferred): marking the eyebrow up as a heading (h1–h6) — it is supplementary; the real heading must own the level (1.3.1).
REVIEW (inferred): using an accent/brand-red eyebrow on a light surface — 13px red on white fails 1.4.3 (text < 4.5:1); keep it text/secondary.
REVIEW (inferred): writing a sentence in the eyebrow — it is a 1–3 word kicker, not a subtitle.

tokenValidation.against: canon token store (semantic-colour.json); declared values match in light + dark (passes _validate_snippets).

provenance.$note: REVIEW: no Figma node yet — surfaced by the journey gap report (the .c-eyebrow hand-util). Needs a design owner + Figma source before promotion from candidate to gated.
